audit_status.source_base: Greek Philippians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for partnership, affection, imprisonment, advance of good news, life/death in Messiah, worthy citizenship.

verses.restored: Paul and Timothy, servants of Messiah Jesus, to all the holy ones in Messiah Jesus who are in Philippi, with overseers and servants/deacons:

familiar.text: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

verses.restored: Grace to you and peace from Divine our Father and Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.restored: I give thanks to my Divine upon every remembrance of you,

familiar.text: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

verses.restored: always in every petition of mine on behalf of all of you, making the petition with joy,

familiar.text: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

verses.restored: because of your partnership/fellowship in the good news from the first day until now,

familiar.text: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

verses.restored: having been persuaded of this very thing: that the One who began in you a good work will complete it until the day of Messiah Jesus.

familiar.text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

verses.restored: It is right for me to think this on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, both in my chains and in the defense and confirmation of the good news, all of you being co-sharers with me of grace.

familiar.text: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

verses.restored: For the Divine is my witness, how I long for all of you in the inward affections of Messiah Jesus.

familiar.text: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

verses.restored: And this I pray: that your love may abound still more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

familiar.text: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

verses.restored: so that you may test the things that differ/excel, so that you may be sincere and without stumbling into the day of Messiah,

familiar.text: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

verses.restored: having been filled with fruit of righteousness/justice through Jesus Messiah, into glory and praise of the Divine.

familiar.text: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

verses.restored: Now I want you to know, siblings, that the things concerning me have come rather into advance of the good news,

familiar.text: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

verses.restored: so that my chains in Messiah have become manifest in the whole praetorium and to all the rest,

familiar.text: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

verses.restored: and most of the siblings, having been persuaded in the Lord by my chains, dare more abundantly to speak the word without fear.

familiar.text: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

verses.restored: Some indeed proclaim Messiah also because of envy and rivalry, but some also because of good pleasure.

familiar.text: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

verses.restored: These out of love, knowing that I am appointed for defense of the good news;

familiar.text: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

verses.restored: but those from selfish ambition proclaim Messiah not purely, thinking to raise pressure for my chains.

familiar.text: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

verses.restored: What then? Only that in every way, whether by pretext or truth, Messiah is proclaimed; and in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will rejoice,

familiar.text: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

verses.restored: for I know that this will turn out for my salvation/healing through your petition and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Messiah,

familiar.text: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

verses.restored: according to my eager expectation and hope, that in nothing I will be ashamed, but with all boldness, as always, even now Messiah will be magnified in my body, whether through life or through death.

familiar.text: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

verses.restored: For to me, to live is Messiah, and to die is gain.

familiar.text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

verses.restored: But if to live in flesh, this is fruitful work for me; and what I will choose, I do not make known.

familiar.text: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

verses.restored: I am held together from the two: having the desire to depart and be with Messiah, for this is much more better,

familiar.text: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

verses.restored: but to remain in the flesh is more necessary because of you.

familiar.text: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

verses.restored: And having been persuaded of this, I know that I will remain and stay with all of you for your progress and joy in the trust,

familiar.text: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

verses.restored: so that your boast may abound in Messiah Jesus in me, through my presence again with you.

familiar.text: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

verses.restored: Only conduct yourselves as citizens worthily of the good news of Messiah, so that whether coming and seeing you or being absent, I may hear the things concerning you: that you stand firm in one Spirit, with one soul/life striving together for the trust of the good news,

familiar.text: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

verses.restored: and not being frightened in anything by those opposing, which is a sign to them of destruction, but of your salvation/healing, and this from the Divine.

familiar.text: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

verses.restored: Because to you it was graciously given on behalf of Messiah, not only to trust in him but also to suffer on behalf of him,

familiar.text: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

verses.restored: having the same struggle such as you saw in me and now hear in me.

familiar.text: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

translation_notes: Koinonia is rendered partnership/fellowship to preserve Philippians' shared-mission tone.
Politeuesthe in 1:27 is rendered conduct yourselves as citizens, anticipating the letter's heavenly citizenship theme.
Paul's body is not dismissed: Messiah is magnified in my body, whether through life or death.
